purpose: fresh standard on-policy data for MC calibration and TD ablation; no environment branching
backbone: UNITAS frozen RoboTwin checkpoint and official action execution
window_exhaustion: stop as infrastructure/feasibility failure; never enter another shard window
split_rule: after full seed/array audit, stratify 32 train and 8 validation using split seed; at least two failures in validation and at least four in train, otherwise stop
admission: six successes and six failures minimum over retained data; smoke excluded
formal_seeds: not allocated; reserve disjoint new sequence after independent method validation

cost_estimate.evidence: previous randomized task five-scene gate took tens of minutes including scene feasibility; failures may use full 1200 action steps
cost_estimate.resources: four assigned simulator GPUs and four separate task-owned model-server GPUs, verified before launch

launch_gate: single standard trajectory smoke passes arrays/actions/labels/finite values and storage checks; new data does not admit same-state pairwise loss
stop: all four fixed shards complete or timeout; no outcome-based extension; interrupted episodes are infrastructure failures and not negative labels
